Folks — quick technical note so MedSys can prepare the right extracts:

- For KMS: we'll need key policy screenshots, a list of CMKs used for token encryption, and CloudTrail entries for key creation/rotate/use for the last 90 days. If MedSys stores keys in an external HSM, please flag that.
- For logs: CloudTrail (management events), S3 access logs, and any VPC flow logs relevant to the endpoint(s). We usually accept 30–90 days depending on the control.
- If you have a consolidated evidence bucket (S3) we can pull direct read-only artifacts — if not, please share exports via the spreadsheet or the Drive link.

I can prepare a minimal example bundle (sanitized) so you can see the exact files we look for. Marissa — can you add a column in the spreadsheet for "example / format" so customers can match?
